question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT league_id, home_team_api_id as team_api_id, home_team_goal as team_goals, away_team_goal as opp_goals FROM Match
  UNION ALL
  SELECT league_id, away_team_api_id as team_api_id, away_team_goal as team_goals, home_team_goal as opp_goals FROM Match
),
team_wins AS (
  SELECT league_id, team_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team_goals > opp_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_wins
  FROM team_matches
  GROUP BY league_id, team_api_id
)
SELECT l.name as league_name, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name, CAST(tw.total_wins AS INTEGER) as total_wins
FROM team_wins tw
JOIN League l ON tw.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON tw.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.total_wins ASC, t.team_long_name ASC) = 1
ORDER BY l.id
